# neotoma

[![Build
Status](https://api.travis-ci.org/ropensci/neotoma.png)](https://travis-ci.org/ropensci/neotoma)
[![Build
status](https://ci.appveyor.com/api/projects/status/t2xyqbs0d8h998cb/branch/master)](https://ci.appveyor.com/project/sckott/neotoma/branch/master)

[![NSF-1550707](https://img.shields.io/badge/NSF-1550707-blue.svg)](https://nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=1550707)
[![NSF-1948926](https://img.shields.io/badge/NSF-1948926-blue.svg)](https://nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=1948926)

**NOTE** *The package `neotoma` has now been deprecated. Unfortunately
our wnapi.neotomadb.org server reached end of life and was no longer
operable. The package has been replaced by
[neotoma2](https://github.com/NeotomaDB/neotoma2). As much as possible
we have kept many of the same patterns, but there are new data
structures. The wnapi server was only passing along data submitted
before June 2020. The new package accesses all data up until the
present. Please contact us directly either by email (<goring@wisc.edu>)
or on our slack workspace (there is an it_r channel) and we can help
assist you in migrating to neotoma2.*

The `neotoma` package is a programmatic R interface to the [Neotoma
Paleoecological Database](http://www.neotomadb.org/). The package is
intended to both allow users to search for sites and to download data
for use in analyical workflows of paleoecological research.

`neotoma` is part of the [rOpenSci](http://ropensci.org) project and is
also hosted on [Figshare](http://dx.doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.677131).
The `neotoma` package has been available on
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=neotoma) since May 3, 2015.

For more information on the package please refer to:

Goring, S., Dawson, A., Simpson, G. L., Ram, K., Graham, R. W., Grimm,
E. C., & Williams, J. W.. (2015). neotoma: A Programmatic Interface to
the Neotoma Paleoecological Database. *Open Quaternary*, 1(1), Art. 2.
DOI: [10.5334/oq.ab](http://doi.org/10.5334/oq.ab)

For ongoing news, issues or information please join the [Neotoma Slack
server](https://bit.ly/2FrZyYD) (and add the \#r channel).
[Slack](http://www.slack.com/) is a real time chat application and
collaboration hub with mobile and desktop applications.

### Development

*We expect no further development of this package, however, we welcome
contributions from any individual, whether code, documentation, or issue
tracking. All participants are expected to follow the [code of
conduct](https://github.com/ROpensci/neotoma/blob/master/code_of_conduct.md)
for this project.*

- [Simon Goring](http://goring.org) - University of Wisconsin-Madison,
  Department of Geography

  Department of Geography

Package functions resolve various Neotoma APIs and re-form the data
returned by the Neotoma database into R data objects. The format of the
Neotoma data, and the actual API functions can be accessed on the
Neotoma API [website](http://api.neotomadb.org/doc/resources/home).

If you have used the package please consider providing us feedback
through a [short
survey](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdRNat6L9grRF0xU5gibkr26xq9jD9wyHgw_AWxhrgn0lWv7w/viewform).

### Install `neotoma`

- CRAN:

``` r

install.packages('neotoma')
```

- Development version from GitHub:

``` r

install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)
install_github("ropensci/neotoma")
library(neotoma)
```

### Currently implemented in `neotoma`

More functions are available through the package help. These represent
the core functions:

- `get_site` - obtain information on sites in the Neotoma dataset (which
  may contain multiple datasets).
  [API](http://api.neotomadb.org/doc/resources/sites)
- `get_dataset` - obtain dataset metadata from Neotoma.
  [API](http://api.neotomadb.org/doc/resources/datasets)
- `get_download` - obtain full datasets (pollen or mammal) from Neotoma.
  [API](http://api.neotomadb.org/doc/resources/downloads)
- `compile_list` - using established pollen-related taxonomies from the
  literature, take the published taxon list and standardize it to allow
  cross site analysis.
- `get_contact` - find contact information for data contributors to
  Neotoma. [API](http://api.neotomadb.org/doc/resources/contacts)
- `get_publication` - obtain publication information from Neotoma.
  [API](http://api.neotomadb.org/doc/resources/publications)
- `get_table` - return matrices corresponding to one of the Neotoma
  database tables.
  [tables](http://api.neotomadb.org/doc/resources/dbtables)
- `get_taxa` - Get taxon information from Neotoma.
  [API](http://api.neotomadb.org/doc/resources/taxa)
- `get_chroncontrol` - Get chronological information used to build the
  age-depth model for the record.
  [API](http://api.neotomadb.org/doc/resources/chroncontrol)

### Recent Changes

- 1.7.6: Updated the API endpoints to correctly point to the new windows
  API endpoint, in preparation for migration; Fixed the help for
  [`get_closest()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_closest.md);
  Changed character encoding for two data tables, `pollen.equiv` and
  `taxon.list`, made them available in the main package using
  [`data()`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/data.html).
- 1.7.4: Bug fix: `get_dataset(gpid=123)` was returning an error, fix
  corrects the error to allow unassigned `x` variables. Updated the
  allowable dataset types for searching to reflect the larger set of
  dataset types within Neotoma.
- 1.7.3: Added numeric/integer methods to the
  [`get_site()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_site.md)
  and
  [`get_dataset()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_dataset.md)
  functions so that a vector of dataset or siteids can be passed to
  improve more general workflow methods.
- 1.7.2: Bugfixes, added the
  [`taxa()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/taxa.md)
  function to easily extract taxa from one or multiple download objects.
- 1.7.1: Bugfix for `compile_download()`, single sample downloads were
  failing to compile properly, added the
  [`taxa()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/taxa.md)
  function to extract taxa lists from large download objects.
- 1.7.0: Added
  [`plot_leaflet()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/plot_leaflet.md)
  to allow interactive exploration of downloaded Neotoma data.
  Integrates with the Neotoma Explorer. Minor bugfix for
  [`get_download()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_download.md)
  to allow records to be sent to Neotoma and to be filtered.
- 1.6.2: Improved the basic
  [`plot()`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html) method based
  on tests against Tilia files in the Neotoma Holding Tank & built more
  robust interpolation in
  [`read_bacon()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/read_bacon.md)
  so that age models without interpolated dates can still be imported.
  [`browse()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/browse.md)
  now opens multiple datastes in the Neotoma Explorer at once.
- 1.6.1: New `Stratiplot()` method, using the `analogue` package to plot
  dataset diagrams from `download` and `download_list` objects, bug
  fixes for
  [`write_agefile()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/write_agefile.md)
  and a new function,
  [`read_bacon()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/read_bacon.md),
  to read in and integrate Bacon chronologies into `download` objects.
- 1.6.0: Support for vector inputs in the `gpid` selection. Added a
  [`get_closest()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_closest.md)
  function to find the closest sample site. Mostly clean-up of reported
  bugs by users. Revised examples for faster check speed.
- 1.5.1: Minor fix to the
  [`get_dataset()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_dataset.md)
  for site level data to account for some datasets with empty submission
  data. Some style changes to code (non-functional changes)
- 1.5.0: More extensive testing to support multiple dataset types. Water
  chemistry datasets still unsupported. Function
  [`read.tilia()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/read.tilia.md)
  added to read Tilia (<http://tiliait.com>) style XML files. Moved to
  using `xml2`, `httr` and `jsonlite` to support parsing.
- 1.4.1: Small changes to
  [`get_geochron()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_geochron.md)
  to address bug reports and improve object `print` methods.
- 1.4.0: Added [`plot()`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html)
  method for datasets, sites & downloads. Fixed a bug with records
  missing chronologies.

### A few examples:

#### Find the distribution of sites with Mammoth fossils in Neotoma

``` r
#  Example requires the mapdata package:
library('mapdata')

#  You may use either '%' or '*' as wildcards for search terms:
test <- get_dataset(taxonname='Mammuthus*')

The API call was successful, you have returned  3273 records.

site.locs <- get_site(test)

# A crude way of making the oceans blue.
plot(1, type = 'n',
     xlim=range(site.locs$long)+c(-10, 10),
     ylim=range(site.locs$lat)+c(-10, 10),
     xlab='Longitude', ylab = 'Latitude')
rect(par("usr")[1],par("usr")[3],par("usr")[2],par("usr")[4],col = "lightblue")
map('world',
    interior=TRUE,
    fill=TRUE,
    col='gray',
    xlim=range(site.locs$long)+c(-10, 10),
    ylim=range(site.locs$lat)+c(-10, 10),
    add=TRUE)

points(site.locs$long, site.locs$lat, pch=19, cex=0.5, col='red')
```

![thing](inst/img/mammothsites.png)

thing

#### Plot the proportion of publications per year for datasets in Neotoma

``` r

# Requires ggplot2
library('ggplot2')
library('plyr')
pubs <- get_publication()

pub.years <- ldply(pubs, "[[", "meta")

ggplot(data=pub.years, aes(x = year)) +
     stat_bin(aes(y=..density..*100, position='dodge'), binwidth=1) +
     theme_bw() +
     ylab('Percent of Publications') +
     xlab('Year of Publication') +
     scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0.1)) +
     scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(pub.years$year, na.rm=TRUE), 2014, by=20))
```

![thing](inst/img/histogramplot.png)

thing

#### Obtain records & Rebuild Chronologies with Bacon

Found at [this
gist](https://gist.github.com/SimonGoring/877dd71cc3ad6bf8531e).
Prepared in part for a Bacon (Blaauw & Christen, 2011) workshop at the
2015 International Limnogeology Conference in Reno-Tahoe, Nevada led by
Amy Myrbo (University of Minnesota).

#### Simple paleo-data visualization

Simple paleo-data visualization in R, linking the `rioja`, `neotoma` and
`dplyr` packages. Found at [this
gist](https://gist.github.com/SimonGoring/dbb4c8e0087882dc143baa89fa041d2b).

### `neotoma` Workshops

We have provided a set of educational tools through the
[NeotomaDB](http://github.com/neotomaDB) GitHub repository in the
[Workshops](http://github.com/NeotomaDB/Workshops) repository. These are
free to share, and can be modified as needed.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Stratiplot(`*`<download>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/Stratiplot.download.md)
  : Palaeoecological stratigraphic diagrams

- [`Stratiplot(`*`<download_list>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/Stratiplot.download_list.md)
  : Palaeoecological stratigraphic diagrams

- [`ages()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/ages.md) :
  Access proxy age data

- [`bind()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/bind.md) :
  Function to bind objects together into a longer object.

- [`browse()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/browse.md) :
  Open a browser window to display a Neotoma dataset within the Neotoma
  Explorer

- [`browse(`*`<dataset>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/browse.dataset.md)
  : Open a browser window to display a Neotoma dataset within the
  Neotoma Explorer

- [`browse(`*`<dataset_list>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/browse.dataset_list.md)
  : Open a browser window to display a Neotoma dataset within the
  Neotoma Explorer

- [`browse(`*`<default>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/browse.default.md)
  : Open a browser window to display a Neotoma dataset within the
  Neotoma Explorer

- [`browse(`*`<download>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/browse.download.md)
  : Open a browser window to display a Neotoma dataset within the
  Neotoma Explorer

- [`browse(`*`<download_list>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/browse.download_list.md)
  : Open a browser window to display a Neotoma dataset within the
  Neotoma Explorer

- [`compile_downloads()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/compile_downloads.md)
  : Compile download objects

- [`compile_taxa()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/compile_taxa.md)
  : Function to convert assemblage taxa to standardized lists.

- [`counts()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/counts.md) :
  Access proxy count data

- [`depths()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/depths.md) :
  Extracts the depth values from a \`download\` object

- [`download`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/download.md)
  : A class for download objects.

- [`get_chroncontrol()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_chroncontrol.md)
  : Function to return chronological control tables used to build age
  models.

- [`get_chroncontrol(`*`<dataset>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_chroncontrol.dataset.md)
  :

  Function to return chronological control tables from a `dataset`.

- [`get_chroncontrol(`*`<dataset_list>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_chroncontrol.dataset_list.md)
  :

  Function to return chronological control tables from a `dataset_list`.

- [`get_chroncontrol(`*`<default>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_chroncontrol.default.md)
  : Function to return chronological control tables from a chronologic
  ID.

- [`get_chroncontrol(`*`<download>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_chroncontrol.download.md)
  :

  Function to return chronological control tables from a `download`
  object.

- [`get_chroncontrol(`*`<download_list>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_chroncontrol.download_list.md)
  :

  Function to return chronological control tables from a `download_list`
  object.

- [`get_closest()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_closest.md)
  : Find the closest dataset records to a site, dataset or long/lat pair
  in Neotoma

- [`get_contact()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_contact.md)
  : Get contact information.

- [`get_dataset()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_dataset.md)
  : Obtain dataset information from the Neotoma Paleoecological Database
  or an existing object.

- [`get_dataset(`*`<default>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_dataset.default.md)
  : Obtain dataset information from the Neotoma Paleoecological Database
  or an existing object.

- [`get_dataset(`*`<download>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_dataset.download.md)
  :

  Obtain dataset information from an existing `download` object.

- [`get_dataset(`*`<download_list>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_dataset.download_list.md)
  :

  Obtain dataset information from a `download_list`.

- [`get_dataset(`*`<geochronologic>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_dataset.geochronologic.md)
  :

  Obtain dataset information from an object of class `geochronologic`.

- [`get_dataset(`*`<geochronologic_list>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_dataset.geochronologic_list.md)
  :

  Obtain dataset information from an object of class
  `geochronologic_list`.

- [`get_dataset(`*`<integer>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_dataset.integer.md)
  : Obtain dataset information from a vector of dataset IDs.

- [`get_dataset(`*`<numeric>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_dataset.numeric.md)
  : Obtain dataset information from a vector of dataset IDs.

- [`get_dataset(`*`<site>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_dataset.site.md)
  :

  Obtain dataset information from an existing `site` object.

- [`get_download()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_download.md)
  :

  Function to return full download records using `site`s, `dataset`s, or
  dataset IDs.

- [`get_download(`*`<dataset>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_download.dataset.md)
  :

  Function to return full download records using a `dataset`.

- [`get_download(`*`<dataset_list>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_download.dataset_list.md)
  :

  Function to return full download records using a `dataset_list`.

- [`get_download(`*`<default>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_download.default.md)
  :

  Function to return full download records using `numeric` dataset IDs.

- [`get_download(`*`<site>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_download.site.md)
  :

  Function to return full download records using a `site`.

- [`get_geochron()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_geochron.md)
  : Function to return geochronological data from records.

- [`get_publication()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_publication.md)
  : A function to get publications for sites or datasets in the Neotoma
  Database using the API.

- [`get_publication(`*`<dataset>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_publication.dataset.md)
  : A function to get publications for datasets in the Neotoma Database
  using the API.

- [`get_publication(`*`<dataset_list>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_publication.dataset_list.md)
  : A function to get publications for dataset_lists in the Neotoma

- [`get_publication(`*`<default>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_publication.default.md)
  : A function to get publications for sites or datasets in the Neotoma

- [`get_publication(`*`<download>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_publication.download.md)
  : A function to get publications for downloads in the Neotoma Database
  using the API.

- [`get_publication(`*`<download_list>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_publication.download_list.md)
  : A function to get publications for datasets in the Neotoma Database
  using the API.

- [`get_site()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_site.md)
  : Return Site Information.

  : Return Site Information from a numeric list of site ids.

  :

  Return Site Information from a `dataset_list`

  : Return Site Information.

  :

  Return Site Information from a `download`

  :

  Return Site Information from a `download_list`

  :

  Return Site Information from a `geochronologic`

  :

  Return Site Information from a `geochronologic_list`

  : Return Site Information from a vector of integers.

- [`get_site(`*`<numeric>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_site.numeric.md)

- [`get_table()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_table.md)
  : Get Neotoma value tables.

- [`get_taxa()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/get_taxa.md)
  : Get taxon information from Neotoma.

- [`gp.table`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/gp.table.md)
  : A list of all the geopolitical entities in the Neotoma database.

- [`plot_leaflet()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/plot_leaflet.md)
  : Leaflet plots for neotoma data.

- [`pollen.equiv`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/pollen.equiv.md)
  : A table to convert the pollen taxa identified by investigators to
  standardized lists.

- [`read.tilia()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/read.tilia.md)
  : Read proxy data from Tilia TLX files

- [`read_bacon()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/read_bacon.md)
  : Function to read in defined Bacon outputs.

- [`taxa()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/taxa.md) :
  Access proxy taxonomic data

- [`taxon.list`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/taxon.list.md)
  : Neotoma taxon list

- [`write_agefile()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/neotoma/reference/write_agefile.md)
  : Write age control file to disk formatted for either Bacon or Clam
